tests.name: asks structural questions before visual recommendations
tests.prompt: Design a landing page for my new SaaS product

assert.description: Should ask structural questions about the product before making visual suggestions
Should not jump to CSS tokens without understanding the product first

tests.name: identifies structural dimensions
tests.prompt: It's a real-time monitoring dashboard for DevOps teams. They use it 8 hours a day watching server health. Downtime costs money.

assert.description: Should identify structural dimensions matching the product's nature

tests.name: proposes a physical analog
tests.prompt: Yes the structural profile is right. It's real-time, high-stakes, multi-stream, daily power users, alerting.

assert.description: Should propose a physical space analog that matches the structural profile

tests.name: derives design from analog not from trends
tests.prompt: Yes the control room analog is perfect. What does that mean for the design?

assert.description: Should derive specific design properties from the analog's physical characteristics
Should not reference design trends as justification

tests.name: applies restraint pass
tests.prompt: I was thinking of adding gradients, rounded corners, and bouncy animations to make it feel modern.

assert.description: Should push back on decoration that contradicts the structural analog

tests.name: validates against universal constants
tests.prompt: What contrast ratio should I use for the dashboard text?

tests.name: uses different analog for calming product
tests.prompt: My product is a meditation and journaling app. Users open it once a day for 10 minutes to reflect.

assert.description: Should propose a calm, contemplative physical space as analog
Should not suggest a high-intensity analog for a calming product

tests.name: connects to companion skills
tests.prompt: This design direction makes sense. What should I do next?

assert.description: Should recommend companion skills for executing the direction

tests.name: explains why with science
tests.prompt: Why does dark mode work better for dashboards?

assert.description: Should explain with neuroscience, not just opinion

tests.name: catches coherence violations in audit
tests.prompt: I'm using flat design with no shadows, but my modals have drop shadows. My buttons are 4px radius but cards are 16px. Is this okay?

assert.description: Should identify the mixed elevation model and mixed radius as coherence violations
